requirements.requirement: Establish the identity of the target person whose year of death is sought.
Establish that the target person was born between 1948 and 1952.
Establish the place in which the target person was born.
Establish the country in which the target person's birth place is located.
Establish that the population of the target person's birth place increased by 5.88% between 2010 and 2020 according to an official website of the country in which that birth place is located.
Establish that in 1990 the target person made a very important presentation at one of the most prominent cultural centers of the country in which the target person's birth place is located.
Establish that the target person did not record any material between 1986 and 1994.
Establish the year of death of the target person.
